text_block_list.text: Today is the Kinko Sho. But Matikanefukukitaru, our rival for the day, has yet to show up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru is a little late, isn't she? I wonder where she could be…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting. I wanted to dress up in something flashy to make a grand entrance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm taking it up a notch, two notches even. You see…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've visited tranquil shrines over a hundred times!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I went to the heart of the mountains and stood beneath a waterfall for five—no—six minutes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And finally, I went to the bargain store and brought home a bounty of lucky goods!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Having absorbed all their lucky power… I stand here transformed, as Full Armor Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: How was that, Bourbon?! I'm getting your shtick right, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Unable to compute. Please try again after resubmitting information.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's a little intimidating… but… but!
Blockading the path to T.M. Opera O stands a towering wall of fortune. Meisho Doto must do whatever it takes to overcome it.
